name: read-on-a-substrate-less-server-answers-not-supported
description: A server that keeps no durable record cannot restore an evicted render for anybody, so a read it cannot serve answers NOT_SUPPORTED on -32006. This is a property of the deployment, not of the locator — which is why the catalog does not grade WHEN the answer is produced. A substrate-less server may answer immediately, before any per-locator work.
